adapters.exportDuty: Leaves with us: every subscription row and webhook body (our entitlements table stores the verbatim notification). Export: the customer and subscription lists (Paddle API, CSV) for the run-off. Cannot move: the card mandates Paddle holds as merchant of record — a switch is a RUN-OFF, existing subscribers renew on Paddle until they lapse.

Leaves with us: the verified webhook bodies and our own GST invoices (Nikatru is seller of record on this rail). Export: payments and subscriptions (Razorpay dashboard reports). Cannot move: UPI AutoPay and e-mandates are bound to Razorpay — a switch is a RUN-OFF.

Leaves with us: the verified webhook bodies and our entitlement rows. Export: the customer list and the app user id mapping (RevenueCat dashboard export). Cannot move: the store subscriptions themselves — Apple and Google bill them, so only the aggregator in front of the stores can change, never the mandate.

c8Seam.why: tooling/capability-register.json records RevenueCat's C-8 seam on the CLIENT (REVENUECAT_KEY, the purchases SDK half). This port is inbound only, so the server verifier sits behind MoRWebhookVerifier while the client half is not ported yet.

unit.verify: services/_shared/src/ports/fakes/payments.ts — no network call, no vendor, no fee

adapters.exportDuty: Nothing leaves: the fake holds in-memory state only, per process, and takes no money. Cannot move: nothing — it serves test only: never sandbox or live (assert-ports limb 7; the door 404s it on every deploy).

_why: BOTH HALVES: inbound is the webhook door (POST /v1/money/<provider>) behind [ADR 004]'s MoRWebhookVerifier, re-exported as RailInbound; outbound is RailOutbound (checkout, cancel, refund, reconcile) in services/_shared/src/ports/payments.ts. Routes reach a rail only through services/platform/src/ports.ts (railFor / inboundFor), which reads the rendered table services/platform/src/generated/ports.ts (tooling/ports/render.mjs).

L3: paddle and the fake call runPaymentsConformance with nothing pending; razorpay and revenuecat call it too and print their pending cases (O-RAZORPAY-CHECKOUT-ADAPTER, O-REVENUECAT-VERIFIER) until those rows close.

generated: true — no hand table remains. The adapter SET (MOR_VERIFIER_IDS), the environments each adapter may serve, every rail's cancel path (derived from its declared capabilities) and the web checkout rail are RENDERED into services/platform/src/generated/ports.ts by tooling/ports/render.mjs (assert-ports limb 3 runs its --check), and the rail price map RAIL_PRICE_IDS[railId][appId][offeringId] by tooling/catalog/render-rail-prices.mjs. The four guards that parsed lib/mor/registry.ts's former literal read the rendered table.
selection.default is null in every environment on purpose: no single rail is THE payments adapter — the channel row decides, and the register cited in `source` is the one place that answer lives.

cost.feeCells are applied by tooling/ops/port-switch.mjs's margin check. revenuecat carries the Apple STANDARD cell, not the Small Business one, because the enrolment cell (apple-small-business-enrolment) has no owner-attested date; india-gst is a tax, not a fee, so no adapter carries it.

identity names sellerOfRecord.<railId> as a tooling/house-identity.json PATH for lane fix-business-facts-reader to source; no seller name is typed here, and port-switch C4 FAILs until the path resolves.
